sentences.en: Good evening, everyone.
sentences.zh: 晚上好，各位。

sentences.en: Let me start by welcoming you all to this talk and thanking you for taking the time to consider joining ACE voluntary organisation.
sentences.zh: 首先，请允许我欢迎大家参加本次讲座，并感谢大家抽出宝贵时间考虑加入ACE志愿组织。

sentences.en: ACE offers support to people and services in the local area and we're now looking for more volunteers to help us do this.
sentences.zh: ACE为本地居民和各类服务机构提供支持，目前我们正招募更多志愿者来协助开展这项工作。

sentences.en: By the way, I hope you're all comfortable - we have brought in extra seats so that no one has.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，希望大家都感到舒适——我们额外增加了座位，以确保没有人需要站立。

sentences.en: to stand, but it does mean that the people at the back of the room may be a bit squashed.
sentences.zh: 但这意味着坐在房间后排的人可能会稍显拥挤。

sentences.en: We'll only be here for about half an hour so, hopefully, that's OK.
sentences.zh: 我们预计停留时间约为半小时，希望这样安排对大家来说可以接受。

sentences.en: One of the first questions we're often asked is how old you need to be to volunteer.
sentences.zh: 我们常被问到的第一个问题通常是：成为志愿者的最低年龄要求是多少？

sentences.en: Well, you can be as young as 16 or you can be 60 or over; it all depends on what type of voluntary work you want to do.
sentences.zh: 实际上，您年满16岁即可参与，或者60岁及以上也完全欢迎；具体取决于您希望从事哪类志愿服务。

sentences.en: Other considerations, such as reliability, are crucial in voluntary work and age isn't related to these, in our experience.
sentences.zh: 其他因素，例如可靠性，在志愿服务中至关重要；而据我们的经验，这些素质与年龄并无关联。

sentences.en: Another question we get asked relates to training.
sentences.zh: 另一个常见问题是关于培训事宜。

sentences.en: Well, there's plenty of that and it's all face-to-face.
sentences.zh: 这方面我们提供大量培训，且全部采用面对面形式。

sentences.en: What's more, training doesn't end when you start working for us - it takes place before, during and after periods of work.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，培训不仅在您开始为我们工作前进行，还会贯穿整个服务期，甚至延续至服务结束后。

sentences.en: Often, it's run by other experienced volunteers as managers tend to prefer to get on with other things.
sentences.zh: 培训通常由其他经验丰富的志愿者主持，因为管理人员往往更倾向于专注于其他事务。

sentences.en: Now, I would ask you to consider a couple of important issues before you decide to apply for voluntary work.
sentences.zh: 接下来，在您决定申请志愿服务之前，请务必认真考虑几个重要问题。

sentences.en: We don't worry about why you want to be a volunteer - people have many different reasons that range from getting work experience to just doing something they've always wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 我们并不在意您为何想成为志愿者——人们参与的原因多种多样，从积累工作经验，到单纯做一件自己一直想做的事，不一而足。

sentences.en: But it is critical that you have enough hours in the day for whatever role /15 we agree is suitable for you - if being a volunteer becomes stressful then it's best not to do it at all.
sentences.zh: 但至关重要的是，您每天必须有足够的时间投入我们共同商定的合适岗位；倘若志愿服务让您感到压力过大，那么最好选择不参与。

sentences.en: You may think that your income is important, but we don't ask about that.
sentences.zh: 您或许会认为自己的收入状况很重要，但我们并不会询问这方面信息。

sentences.en: It's up to you to decide if you can work without earning money.
sentences.zh: 是否能在无薪状态下工作，完全由您自行决定。

sentences.en: What we value is dedication.
sentences.zh: 我们真正看重的是奉献精神。

sentences.en: Some of our /15 most loyal volunteers earn very little themselves but still give their full energy to the work they do with us.
sentences.zh: 我们一些最忠诚的志愿者自身收入微薄，却依然全身心投入与我们共同开展的工作。

sentences.en: OK, so let's take look at some of the work areas that we need volunteers for and the sort of things that would help you in those.
sentences.zh: 好的，接下来让我们了解一下当前亟需志愿者参与的工作领域，以及哪些能力或特质有助于胜任这些工作。

sentences.en: You may wish simply to help us raise money.
sentences.zh: 您可能仅希望协助我们开展筹款活动。

sentences.en: If you have the creativity to come up with an imaginative or novel way of fundraising, we'd be delighted, as standing in the local streets or shops with a collection box can be rather boring!
sentences.zh: 如果您富有创意，能提出新颖、富想象力的筹款方式，我们将非常欣喜；毕竟，只是手持募捐箱站在当地街道或商店里，确实略显枯燥！

sentences.en: One outdoor activity that we need volunteers for is litter collection and for this it's useful if you can walk for long periods. sometimes uphill.
sentences.zh: 我们有一项户外活动需要志愿者参与——即垃圾清理工作；若您能长时间步行，有时还需爬坡，将尤为适合。

sentences.en: Some of our regular collectors are quite elderly, but very active and keen to protect the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们一些长期从事清理工作的志愿者年龄较大，但身体活跃、环保意识强烈。

sentences.en: If you enjoy working with children, we have three vacancies for what are called 'playmates'.
sentences.zh: 如果您喜欢与儿童共事，我们目前有三个‘玩伴’岗位空缺。

sentences.en: These volunteers help children learn about staying healthy through a range of out-of-school activities.
sentences.zh: 这些志愿者通过一系列课外活动，帮助儿童学习保持健康的知识。

sentences.en: You don't need to have children yourself, but it's good if you know something about nutrition and can give clear instructions.
sentences.zh: 您本人无需有子女，但若了解营养学知识并能清晰下达指令，则会很有帮助。

sentences.en: If that doesn't appeal to you, maybe you would be interested in helping out at our story club for disabled children, especially if you have done some acting.
sentences.zh: 如果这一岗位不吸引您，或许您会对协助我们为残障儿童开设的故事俱乐部感兴趣，尤其当您具备一定的表演经验时。

sentences.en: We put on three performances a year based on books they have read and we're always looking for support with the theatrical side of this.
sentences.zh: 我们每年基于孩子们阅读过的书籍举办三场演出，始终欢迎各方支持，特别是戏剧相关环节。

sentences.en: The last area I'll mention today is first aid.
sentences.zh: 今天我要介绍的最后一个领域是急救。

sentences.en: Volunteers who join this group can end up teaching others in vulnerable groups who may be at risk of injury.
sentences.zh: 加入该小组的志愿者，最终可能为易受伤的弱势群体成员提供急救知识教学。

sentences.en: Initially, though, your priority will be to take in a lot of information and not forget any important steps or details.
sentences.zh: 不过，初期您的首要任务是大量吸收信息，并牢记所有关键步骤与细节。

sentences.en: Right, so does anyone have any questions .
sentences.zh: 好了，现在大家有什么问题吗？
